Illustration of the bug:

```bash
LLM_OPENAI_SHOW_RESPONSES=1 llm 'hi' -m gpt-6-luna --async
```
Outputs:
> `Error: Invalid `http_client` argument; Expected an instance of `httpx.AsyncClient` or `httpx2.AsyncClient` but got <class 'httpx2.Client'>`

With this fix applied, it outputs:

```
Request: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/responses
  Headers:
    host: api.openai.com
    connection: keep-alive
    authorization: [...]
    accept: application/json
    content-type: application/json
    user-agent: AsyncOpenAI/Python 3.3.1
    x-stainless-lang: python
    x-stainless-package-version: 3.3.1
    x-stainless-os: MacOS
    x-stainless-arch: arm64
    x-stainless-runtime: CPython
    x-stainless-runtime-version: 3.15.0
    x-stainless-async: async:asyncio
    x-stainless-retry-count: 0
    x-stainless-read-timeout: 600
    content-length: 164
  Body:
    {
      "include": [
        "reasoning.encrypted_content"
      ],
      "input": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "hi"
        }
      ],
      "model": "gpt-6-luna",
      "reasoning": {
        "summary": "auto"
      },
      "store": false,
      "stream": true
    }
Response: status_code=200
...
```
